about_the_game:
🔹 About the Game

We Escape Forever is a 1–6 player first-person co-op survival horror game, where you and your team must solve puzzles and survive mysterious, dreamlike environments to escape.
The rule is simple: everyone must survive for the escape to be real—no one gets left behind.

🧩 Core Features

  • Co-op Multiplayer (1–6 players)
    Survive and escape together. If even one player dies, the escape fails. Teamwork is everything.

  • An Ever-Expanding Dream
    This game is continuously updated with new maps, features, and mechanics.
    Each update adds more surreal environments to explore and survive, making the dream feel deeper and more real.

  • Danger Lurks in Every Corner
    Each map is inhabited by hostile beings—unnatural threats that react to sight, sound, or movement.
    You must avoid them while completing objectives. The threat is always watching, always hunting.

  • Puzzle-Based Escape Gameplay
    Escape isn’t handed to you—you have to earn it. Solve creative, cooperative puzzles like:
    • Fueling a generator by collecting scattered gas cans to restore power
    • Unlocking sealed doors by locating and playing hidden videotapes
    • And more to come with future updates

  • Immersive First-Person Experience
    Designed for full immersion, the game uses realistic visuals, spatial audio, and atmospheric design
    to make each run feel like you’re trapped inside a lucid dream.

♾️ Why We Escape Forever?

This isn’t a game you play once and forget.
It’s a living world of dreams and memories, constantly evolving.
Every new map brings new memories.
And those memories?
They start to feel familiar—like déjà vu.

Even though you know it's just a game…
You’ll want to stay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision .1350
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11 (Latest Feature Update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: We Escape Forever is a co-op survival horror game for 1–6 players. Solve puzzles and escape dream worlds. Explore eerie environments, avoid terrifying entities, and survive together. Built with Unreal Engine 5, the game adds new levels and content regularly, offering fresh challenges.
